_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV decroissante: revenu, store count, same-store metrics, managed business (asset-light), occupancy.

kpis.signal: Saut majeur 2023 via Merger Life Storage (juillet 2023). Croissance modeste 2025 reflete environnement self-storage post-COVID
kpis.description_fr: CA total Extra Space Storage (rental income + tenant reinsurance + managed fees). Merger Life Storage juillet 2023 a transforme la base.
kpis.description_en: Extra Space Storage total revenue (rental income + tenant reinsurance + managed fees). Life Storage Merger July 2023 transformed base.

kpis.signal: 2,007 wholly-owned + 11 cons JV + 407 unconsol JV en 2025. Saut Life Storage juillet 2023. Stable depuis (-0.5%)
kpis.description_fr: Stores en propriete totale (wholly-owned + JV consolides + JV non-consolides). Capacite generatrice de rental revenue directe.
kpis.description_en: Total stores owned (wholly-owned + consolidated JV + unconsolidated JV). Direct rental revenue generation capacity.

kpis.signal: Activite asset-light, croissance 17.8%/an. Modele plateforme management plus rentable que pure ownership
kpis.description_fr: Stores geres pour proprietaires tiers (asset-light fees). Activite haute marge, croissance soutenue. 1,856 fin 2025 (+281 vs 2024).
kpis.description_en: Stores managed for third-party owners (asset-light fees). High-margin activity, sustained growth. 1,856 end 2025 (+281 vs 2024).

kpis.signal: Plus grand operator self-storage US. 43 etats + DC. Marque dominante du secteur
kpis.description_fr: Footprint total Extra Space (owned + managed). #1 operator US self-storage. 43 etats + Washington DC. Reseau densifie.
kpis.description_en: Extra Space total footprint (owned + managed). #1 US self-storage operator. 43 states + Washington DC. Densified network.

kpis.signal: KPI #1 REIT self-storage. Pic 2021 (COVID-induced demand). Stabilisation autour 92-93% en 2025
kpis.description_fr: Taux occupation portefeuille same-store (pool 1,804 stores en 2025). Indicateur de pricing power et demande structurelle.
kpis.description_en: Same-store portfolio occupancy (1,804 stores pool in 2025). Pricing power and structural demand indicator.

kpis.signal: Baisse 2025 (-1.7%) traduit hausse charges (taxes proprietes, masse salariale, marketing). KPI REIT cle pour valuation
kpis.description_fr: Net Operating Income du pool same-store (1,804 stores). Mesure pure de rentabilite operationnelle excluant croissance externe.
kpis.description_en: Net Operating Income for same-store pool (1,804 stores). Pure operating profitability measure excluding external growth.
